scope: Image anatomy review only; 3D topology and bone weights require separate validation

images.prompt: Create a SINGLE technical modeling reference image from the approved character design provided. Preserve the EXACT character identity, face, outfit, colors, construction, proportions and number of appendages. Change the pose to a strict symmetrical front orthographic T-pose: shoulders level, both upper arms and forearms straight horizontally at shoulder height, elbows fully extended naturally, wrists straight, palms facing the camera, all five fingers spread distinctly with correct thumb placement. Full body including both fingertips and soles, ample margin. Feet planted flat facing forward, legs separated slightly, upright torso. Precise readable anatomy and joint transitions, consistent left/right construction, clean armor boundaries and straps. Gunfire Reborn style chunky hand-painted matte game character, restrained angular planes. Plain light gray background, flat neutral studio illumination, minimal shadow, no dramatic perspective, no weapons, no text, no turnarounds or inset panels. This is a technical T-pose reference, not an action illustration. FOX requirements: exactly TWO hands, each with FIVE fingers (one thumb plus four fingers). Exactly TWO feet, each with FOUR visible separated orange toes and four pale claws; boot cuffs must leave the toes clear. Exactly THREE large fox tails TOTAL: one on viewer-left behind the body, TWO on viewer-right behind the body at distinct heights. Never add a fourth tail. Keep all tails behind and below the horizontal arms, do not obscure the hands. Keep the approved red scarf, leather chest armor, indigo trousers, pale chest fur and orange fox face.
